steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Command words tell you exactly what the examiner expects: 'describe' means give an account, 'explain' means give reasons, 'analyse' means break down and examine, 'evaluate' means make a judgement. | Key Fact: Describe questions require you to identify and outline film language features or production contexts without needing to explain their effect. | Key Fact: Explain questions require you to give reasons why something produces a particular effect or meaning, connecting technique to impact. | Key Fact: Analyse questions require you to break down a sequence or concept into its component parts and examine how they work together to create meaning.
